verdict: 0 BLOCKING, 2 MATERIAL, 3 MINOR, 1 QUESTION over e33173c5..65a740ba (mmnto-ai/totem#3009): converged on the core semantics. Not falsified: heal:true matches the base commit byte for byte (warn strings, nukeAndReset, return, detectFtsIndex order); no heal:false path reaches nukeAndReset; releaseHandles is synchronous, cannot throw and touches nothing on disk; the typed error's class identity holds across packages (core built by tsc, one import); search_knowledge's per-query reconnect failures are caught and rendered with the cure and a refused reconnect leaves no half-open state for the next query (reads reopen a snapshot); the CLI boundary prints Fix: <recoveryHint> and exits 1; shield.ts:939 is the learn-path dedup only; the pipeline's heal runs before its empty check, so the corruption arm never leaves a partial index; both totem-context directives sit on catches that record or warn in every branch. The two material findings (a skipped linked store stayed skipped for the server session; a primary-store fault failed every tool that loads the context) and the minors are folded at 8760a1fc; a scoped re-armed read covers that fold.

findings.claim: A linked store that throws StoreNeedsRebuildError at init was dropped from linkedStores and the context cached, so after the user ran the cure the link stayed out of federated search until a server restart; at base the emptied store was registered and a later sync was picked up.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED: the skipped link is kept in pendingLinkedStores; _reconnectOnContext retries connect() on each pending store and on success moves it into linkedStores and clears its init warning; the skip message says until it opens on a later reconnect or the server restarts; a test rebuilds the store and sees it rejoin. The retry fires only on the two reconnect callers (after add_lesson's sync, or on a failed search), which the changeset states.

findings.claim: The uncaught primary connect in initContext made getContext() reject for every tool, so verify_execution (which needs only the project root) and add_lesson (whose own spawned sync is the rebuilder) failed on a store fault that base had healed silently.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED: getProjectBasics() resolves root and config without opening the store; verify_execution uses it and never opens the store; add_lesson catches StoreNeedsRebuildError, writes the lesson, runs its sync and reports the rebuild; describe_project already caught any context error and was not affected. Tests on each.

findings.claim: The linked warnings embedded the full error message (with its [Totem Error] prefix and the cure) and then appended the cure again.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED: StoreNeedsRebuildError.detail carries the bare reason; both warnings print detail then recoveryHint once.

findings.claim: The doc listed the MCP server as hands-off while review --learn's and add_lesson's embedded syncs still rebuild, and neither the doc nor the changeset said the strict pre-push review gate now fails closed and loud on a store fault.
findings.counterexample: FOLDED: the doc names every reader that stops with the cure, the two embedded syncs that still rebuild, and the gate's loud failure; review-learn and lesson extract, which open the store before their sync, are named as stopping before writing.
